answer_1.quote: In neural machine translation (NMT), autoregressive models decode tokens one-by-one: p(Y |X) = T i p(y i |y ≤i |X), which ensures the robustness of intrinsic language models but slows down the inference.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates target language sentences from source language sentences using non-autoregressive generation with iterative refinement.
